"Create a complete mobile game inspired by the classic Zombie Farm.

GAME TITLE: Zombie Farm – The Undead Kingdom

IMPORTANT: I want a real playable farming and management game, NOT a racing game, platformer, side-scroller, or simple visual demo.

VISUAL STYLE AND CAMERA

- Beautiful colorful cartoon graphics.
- Isometric 3/4 top-down camera, similar to the original Zombie Farm.
- The entire farm should be visible and explorable.
- Detailed cartoon zombies, plants, buildings, trees, and decorations.
- Smooth animations and polished visual effects.
- Landscape mobile orientation.

MAIN GAMEPLAY

The player starts with a small abandoned farm and gradually transforms it into a huge zombie kingdom.

The player can:

1. Plant zombie seeds in farming plots.
2. Wait for crops to grow.
3. Harvest zombie plants.
4. Collect coins and resources.
5. Create and collect different zombie types.
6. Build and upgrade structures.
7. Expand the farm by unlocking new land.
8. Complete missions and earn rewards.

ZOMBIE COLLECTION

Create at least 15 unique zombie characters, including:

- Regular Zombie
- Farmer Zombie
- Soldier Zombie
- Ninja Zombie
- Fire Zombie
- Ice Zombie
- Giant Zombie
- Armored Zombie
- Legendary Zombies

Each zombie must have unique artwork, stats, animations, rarity, and upgrade levels.

FARM BUILDING

Implement a functional building system:

- Zombie Laboratory
- Farmhouse
- Seed Shop
- Zombie Houses
- Training Center
- Storage
- Defensive Towers
- Decorations

Allow players to place buildings on the farm grid, move them, upgrade them, and unlock new buildings.

PROGRESSION

- Player experience and levels from 1 to 50.
- XP rewards for harvesting, building, and missions.
- Unlock new crops, zombies, buildings, and territories.
- Daily missions and achievements.
- A balanced coin and gem economy.

STORY MODE

Create a complete story about a farmer surviving a zombie apocalypse and discovering a mysterious zombie-growing technology.

Include chapters, NPC characters, dialogue, quests, boss battles, and new locations.

ADVENTURE

Add an adventure map where the player sends zombie teams to explore dangerous areas, fight enemies, defeat bosses, and collect rare materials.

USER INTERFACE

Create polished mobile-friendly menus:

- Farm
- Inventory
- Zombie Collection
- Shop
- Missions
- World Map
- Player Level
- Settings

All buttons must work.

SAVE SYSTEM

Implement automatic saving and loading. Preserve player progress, coins, inventory, buildings, crops, zombie collection, and unlocked areas after closing the game.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

- Optimize for Android mobile browsers.
- Touch-friendly controls.
- Smooth performance.
- Offline single-player gameplay where supported.
- Use functional gameplay mechanics rather than decorative elements.
- Use original assets and avoid copying copyrighted game files.

DEVELOPMENT PRIORITY

Build the actual game, not just a concept.

Start by creating the complete playable farm with:

- Isometric camera.
- Working farming plots.
- Planting and harvesting.
- Zombie characters.
- Building placement.
- Coins and XP.
- Functional menus.
- Persistent saving.

Then implement the story, adventure, combat, additional zombies, and progression.

Test every mechanic and fix broken interactions before considering the game complete.

If the platform cannot implement everything in one generation, continue developing the SAME game and preserve all existing systems and assets. Never replace the existing game with a new prototype.

FINAL RESULT: A polished, complete, addictive Zombie Farm-inspired mobile game.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
